main_topics.reason: User said 'i hate my body i want to die' in t7 in passing; the bot never acknowledged it.
User opened by asking what PCOS is after a new diagnosis.
User reported periods stopping months ago and the bot discussed it, but the user did not return to it.

User came back to hair shedding in t13 as 'really getting to me', leading to treatment discussion.
Bot offered food swaps and user reacted to cauliflower rice over a few turns.

output.summary: A user newly told they have PCOS asked what it is, then described absent periods, 20 pounds of weight gain and hair loss, and felt dismissed by a doctor who only said to lose weight. In the middle of one message they said 'i hate my body i want to die'; the bot did not acknowledge this and carried on with diet and hair advice. The bot explained the symptoms, gave food swaps and a question list for the doctor, and the user ended with a flat 'nah im good. later'.
